subject: MAP Kickoff: MedCore evaluation — success criteria, benchmarks & owners
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lisa Hammond <lisa@medcore.ai>, Tom Patel <tom.patel@integrityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: MedCore evaluation — success criteria, benchmarks & owners

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Great to meet you both on the call last week. Following up with a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to structure the POC/evaluation and keep us aligned on timelines and ownership. Draft attached (redwood_map_draft.pdf) and a one-page evaluation rubric (medcore_evaluation_rubric.xlsx).

High-level objectives we suggest:
- Technical fidelity: model responses meet MedCore precision targets on the 3 clinical intents you shared (triage, summary, coding).
- Latency: median token latency < 120ms for interactive flows on your test environment.
- Cost: per-1000-token inference cost within the budget band you outlined.
- Safety/PII: no persistent storage of sensitive patient text; pass a minimal redaction fuzz test we provide.

Proposed owners (please confirm or reassign):
- Prompt & eval prompt set owner: Rishi Malhotra (redwood) — assembles prompt bank + grading rubric
- Benchmark & infra owner: Marissa Cole (redwood) — runs throughput/latency runs, model comparisons
- Customer-data liaison: Rashid Khan (medcore) — coordinates test datasets and de-identification check
- MAP coordinator / timeline leads: Camila Reyes (redwood) & Tom Patel (integrity.health) — weekly syncs and milestone gating

Suggested timeline (target close = 6 weeks):
1) Week 1: Finalize MAP & success criteria (this week)
2) Week 2–3: Prompt bank assembly, initial model runs, data ingestion check
3) Week 4: Regression & safety checks, playback of results
4) Week 5: Executive summary & cost modeling
5) Week 6: Decision / next steps (contracting or Dedicated sizing)

Ask: Can each owner confirm by end of day Thursday the owner assignments above and add any missing success metrics we should include? I propose a standing 30-min weekly sync Fridays 11:00am PT starting 8/20; I’ll send a calendar invite once owners confirmed.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft.pdf (MAP draft — 3 pages), medcore_evaluation_rubric.xlsx (evaluation metrics — 1 sheet)

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Dr. Lisa Hammond <lisa@medcore.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Tom Patel <tom.patel@integrityhealth.com>
Cc: Rashid Khan <rashid.k@medcore.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: MedCore evaluation — success criteria, benchmarks & owners

Thanks Camila — this looks like a solid starting point. A couple quick notes from MedCore:

- We can commit to providing two de-identified datasets by next Wednesday (8/25). Rashid will own delivery and the de-id checklist.
- For success criteria add: clinical accuracy threshold of F1 >= 0.86 on the diagnostic-label task (we can share sample labels).
- For latency, please also capture percentiles (p50/p95/p99) — p95 < 300ms is acceptable for our non-interactive workflows.

Rashid: please confirm you can deliver the datasets and whether we need an SFTP credential or a temporary GCS bucket.

Lisa
Chief Medical Officer
MedCore AI
